findings.issue: Optimistic updates are only applied to message send; edit, delete, and reactions call the API synchronously with no optimistic placeholder
findings.impact: Edit/delete/reaction interactions feel slower because the UI waits for the server round-trip before updating.
findings.fix: Wrap handleEdit and handleDelete in useOptimistic with temp-ID rollback; apply optimistic reaction toggles locally before the API call.

findings.issue: deduplicateEcho uses a synchronous boolean read from inside a setItems callback to check for duplicates, which may produce stale reads under React concurrent rendering
findings.impact: Under React concurrent mode or batched state updates, the synchronous exists check may incorrectly return false, causing duplicate messages.
findings.fix: Use useRef<Set<string>> to track seen IDs outside the state update cycle for server-echo deduplication.

findings.issue: Failed optimistic sends are silently removed with no inline retry UI — the rollback simply filters out the temp message
findings.impact: Users see their message disappear after a send failure with no way to retry, causing confusion and data loss.
findings.fix: Display inline retry button on failed messages using the errors map from useOptimistic; implement resubmit callback.
